text:
Ava: Quick brainstorm — finalizing the benchmark narrative for the launch. Thinking a small set of charts that make a tight latency -> $/token story tied to real user workloads. Aim: clear CTA for signups + webinar leads. Thoughts?
Noah: Love the direction. Suggest one scatter (latency vs $/k tokens), one tail-latency histogram, and a short timeline showing perceived delay for users.
Maria: For the landing page we should test two CTAs: 'See projected savings' vs 'Run your app on Redwood (free credits)'. We can A/B.
Chris: I can run a microbenchmark against a simulated 50-concurrent chat workload and a 95th-tail trace from production anonymized logs. Will produce numbers and a CSV.
Taylor: I can mock up 3 tile layouts: scatter, histogram, timeline. Need the numbers and a short narrative line for each tile (1–2 sentences).
Noah: Also capture an example cost calc: e.g. 1M tokens/day => $X/day with our batching + cache. Makes it tangible.
Ava: Webinar format question: live demo vs prerecord + live Q/A. My vote: prerecord the demo to avoid flub, do 20m live Q/A.
Maria: Routing play: webinar registrants who attend + ask a product question -> tag as MQL, send to SDR. If lead.score > 80 or company_size > 200 => route to AE. Zapier -> HubSpot flow ok?
Chris: Running the runs now. Expect CSV + short note about assumptions (model size, quantization, batching policy). ETA: EOD.
Taylor: Copy roughs for tile text: "Latency that feels instant. Costs that scale with your usage." Want feedback: is 'feels instant' too wishy?
Noah: Slightly vague. Maybe: "Tail latency under 200ms for interactive chat; 40% lower per-token cost at typical chat workloads." Concrete wins sell.
Ava: Agree. Use a one-line claim + one-data-point subline. E.g. claim: '40% lower per-token cost for chat workloads' subline: 'measured across 50-concurrent sessions, median response 120ms, 95th 420ms.'
Maria: For lead capture: add a short checkbox on signup "Share my use case for tailored cost estimates" — if checked push sample prompts to product team.
Chris: snippet of the run command I'll use (for transparency for the ticket):
```bash
python tools/bench_chat.py --concurrency 50 --duration 1800 --model redwood-xxl --quant q4_0 --batch_policy continuous --output bench_6789.csv
```
Chris: Will also produce the minimal analysis script so Taylor can generate charts directly from CSV.
EventBot: Webinar draft scheduled: 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC — placeholder. Host: Ava.
Ava: Great. Final asks for this thread: 1) Chris: numbers + CSV + small assumptions note by EOD. 2) Taylor: 3 mock PNGs (tiles) + alt copy by tomorrow noon. 3) Maria: Zap -> HubSpot playbook draft with routing rules + SDR script by tomorrow EOD. Noah and I will assemble the deck and rehearsal.
Noah: I'll add a single-slide cost calculator that marketing can embed on the landing page (input tokens/day, output monthly cost). Will wire up with sample numbers.
Taylor: Will do color comps: fast=teal, balanced=navy, cheap=gold. Will keep accessible contrast.
Maria: I'll sketch the webhook field mapping for HubSpot and the lead scoring rules and paste into the ticket.
Ava: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll lock this as the narrative: microbench-backed "latency -> dollars" tiles, concrete claim + 1 supporting datapoint, prerecord demo + live Q/A, webinar leads routed to SDR->AE with score threshold.
Noah: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks team — I'll open the deck issue and tag everyone.
